description: Dusk or night on a stone quay by dark water. On the left, a wooden ship's gangplank with a woman holding a torch; a group of people in dark cloaks and period dress come down it, including an elderly bearded man with a cane, a woman in a white headscarf, and a woman in a black shawl holding a baby. On the right, a man in a white turban and maroon fur-trimmed robe holds out one open hand in welcome, with a lantern-carrying guard beside him. Behind the water, sailing ships and a silhouette of a city with domes and minarets under a stormy sky. No visible text, no frame, nothing graphic.
